releaseNotes.content:
## Introduction

Configuration script for FrSky XAct.

## V2.0.1

- Introduced more configurable parameters for XAct.

## V2.0.2

- Move to device config category Servos.

## V2.0.3

- Add back the configuration with the S.Port interface. (Need ETHOS greater than or equal to version 26.1.1)
- Introduce i18n support.

## V2.0.4

- Fix the negative center value display error.

## V2.0.5

- Fixed an issue where device could not be configured when telemetry data was received from an external module.

## V2.0.6

- Added missing translation.

If you are running Ethos 1.6.0 or later, you can find it in the Device Config menu.
